jobs.title: Analyst - Data Science - Consulting - SH

major.raw: Prefer majors in Business Analytics, Information Management, Statistics, Finance, Economics, Computer Science and other related majors

jobs.jobDescription: Join Deloitte China Deloitte China provides integrated professional services to our clients with a one-stop shop offering of world-leading audit, tax, and consulting services. • We are the world's largest professional services firm that changes the world, leading with purpose and shared values. • We are market leader in digital and innovative solutions, creating value for client through our multi-disciplinary services. • We are certified as one of the ‘Best Workplaces™ in Greater China and recognized as a Top Employer in China by the Top Employers Institute* since 2006！ Consulting provides enduring value to the world's most important organizations. With 7000+ consulting and delivery practitioners, Deloitte consulting delivers innovative solutions through Strategy, Risk & Transactions and Technology & Transformation. Across disciplines, we connect the optimal mix of Deloitte's industry, functional and technology capabilities with the best of our Alliances to orchestrate the outcomes our clients seek. We aspire to be our clients' Most Valuable Partner, with our people, platforms and AI integral to creating shared value at the heart of their business. Work you will do As a part of Data Science CoE (CoE), you will join a team that allows you to build strong skills in AI. You will have the opportunity to work in-depth across digital transformation and data-related topics. CoE solutions harness the power of analytics, automation, and artificial intelligence (AI) to uncover hidden relationships from vast amounts of data in the clients' organization. Implementing the right strategy and digitalization requires balancing speed, cost, and quality to deliver measurable business value. We offer three core services: • Enterprise Analytics & AI Strategy – You will have the opportunity to communicate with CDO and CIO to design and implement enterprise-wide strategies which integrate leading analytics and AI capabilities across a client's value chain to build an Insight-Driven Organization • Cognitive Insights & Engagement – You will have the opportunity to work with client's business analysis and data science teams to generate insights which catalyze growth and engage stakeholders using Science-based capabilities, Machine Learning and AI platforms • Data & AI Application– You will have the opportunity to coordinate with business and IT departments to design and implement large scale data programs, AI algorithms and smart decision platforms that promote organizational intelligence and scientific decision-making In your first few years with us, you will have the opportunity to work on projects across multiple industries, customers and services, helping build your core personal and professional capabilities. Join us and you will be part of an elite team of colleagues who are active, innovative, inclusive and collaborative. During your tenure as an analyst in CoE, you will demonstrate and develop your leadership and professional capabilities in the following areas: Building diverse capability, Collaborating, Creating purpose, Delivering value, Driving agility, Influencing, Inspiring, Building the Business, Analytical Acumen, Effective Communication, Delivery Excellence, Managing Change, Strategic Thinking & Problem Solving and Tech Savviness.
jobs.jobRequirements: • Prefer majors in Business Analytics, Information Management, Statistics, Finance, Economics, Computer Science and other related majors • Strong logical, analytical, problem-solving, and interpersonal skills • Always takes the initiative, self-motivated, able to work under pressure and willing to travel • Demonstrated leadership skills and ability to collaborate in a team environment (extracurricular activities, internship experience, etc.) will be a bonus • Experienced in machine learning with Python (including but not limited to Pandas, Numpy, Scikit-learn), being familiar with Generative AI will be a bonus • A fast learner and a strong team player • Creative, flexible and self-confident • Fluent in spoken and written Mandarin and English; proficiency in any other international language is a bonus At Deloitte, we know we’re at our best when we look out for one another; prioritize respect, fairness, development and wellbeing; foster an inclusive culture and embrace diversity in all forms. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of their background, experience, identity, ability or thinking style, and if you need assistance or an accommodation during the application process for accessibility reasons this is available upon request. The preferred candidate will be subject to background screening by Deloitte or by their external third-party provider. Start your new chapter with us Ready to take on new challenges? It's your time to shine. Apply now! Stay connected for the latest career opportunities Follow us on WeChat 德勤招聘 Accessibility assistance If you need assistance or an accommodation during the recruitment process for accessibility reasons, there will be an opportunity for you to let us know what you need once you begin your application.

Across disciplines, we connect the optimal mix of Deloitte's industry, functional and technology capabilities with the best of our Alliances to orchestrate the outcomes our clients seek. We aspire to be our clients' Most Valuable Partner, with our people, platforms and AI integral to creating shared value at the heart of their business. China Japan Collaboration Analyst Role Description To navigate the future with confidence, organizations need to make the right choices: clear, timely and inspirational choices that deliver growth in a dynamic, disrupted world. Monitor Deloitte's strategy practitioners have combined deep industry insights with cutting-edge methods to help leaders resolve their most critical decisions, drive value, and achieve transformational success. As an Analyst in the China Japan Collaboration team, you’ll join a highly collaborative team in a fast-paced environment that exposes you to a variety of experiences across industries (Automotive, Consumer Products & Retail, Life Sciences & Healthcare, Insurance, Oil Gas & Chemical, TMT, etc.) disciplines, and geographies. You will work alongside industry-leading clients to help them make decisions and implement enhancements to their strategy, productivity, performance, and long-term profitability. You will have the opportunity to exercise strong analytical and critical thinking skills to solve complex problems and communicate your findings to senior leaders. As an Analyst in the China Japan Collaboration team, you are comfortable with ambiguity and enjoy learning quickly to make an impact. You will be successful by demonstrating a breadth and depth of capabilities to take on a variety of business, technological and organizational challenges. Examples may include helping clients define their strategic direction based on analyzing structured and unstructured data; sensing market and technology trends to anticipate changes and make strategic choices; implementing new innovations and ventures; re-designing business capabilities; and architecting innovative operating models to drive organic growth. You will also have the opportunity to collaborate with cross offering portfolio teams at Deloitte Consulting on end-to-end Digital, Analytics and Cloud transformations, to help some of the largest and most innovative organizations address their most complex and pressing business challenges, and deliver concrete results. Your success will be enabled and empowered by Deloitte Consulting's broad platform that puts talent first. We invest passionately in trainings and coaching to guide you through your Deloitte career. Most importantly, we are a caring community that celebrates diversity and inclusion.
jobs.jobRequirements: We are looking for exceptional individuals from top tier schools to join us. Required qualifications include: • Outstanding track record of academic performance (minimum GPA of 3.5) with a continuous learning attitude • Have a strong grasp of structured problem-solving skills and analytical skills • Strong Interest in understanding emerging business models, industry trends and market dynamics • Have a basic understanding of emerging trends and technologies as they relate to strategy (e.g. Digital, AI, Data) • Demonstrated leadership skills making a positive social impact a bonus • Ability to collaborate in a team environment (extracurricular activities, internship experience, etc.) • Exceptional interpersonal, communications and presentation skills • Fluent in spoken and written Japanese, Mandarin and English. Experience of studying or living in Japan will be a bonus. • Interested or experienced in Automotive industry will be a bonus At Deloitte, we know we’re at our best when we look out for one another; prioritize respect, fairness, development and wellbeing; foster an inclusive culture and embrace diversity in all forms. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of their background, experience, identity, ability or thinking style, and if you need assistance or an accommodation during the application process for accessibility reasons this is available upon request. The preferred candidate will be subject to background screening by Deloitte or by their external third-party provider. Start your new chapter with us Ready to take on new challenges? It's your time to shine. Apply now! Stay connected for the latest career opportunities Follow us on WeChat 德勤招聘 Accessibility assistance If you need assistance or an accommodation during the recruitment process for accessibility reasons, there will be an opportunity for you to let us know what you need once you begin your application.
